review:
John Hunter and the Book of Tut Respin adds a respin mechanic to the familiar book formula. In any base-game spin, a random mystery symbol can be chosen to expand across the reels, which triggers a respin. More mystery symbols can land during respins, and the sequence continues until the chosen symbol fails to appear.

Three or more book scatters award 10 free spins, and here you get to choose your expanding symbol rather than leave it to chance. Expanding it again triggers further respins, and three more books retrigger the round. Pragmatic Play's page and the game's own screens quote different maximum wins, so we have not listed a figure. The RTP is 96.5%. The base-game respins make this more lively than a standard book slot.
